messages:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired by synthetic-checks (INC-123456) - check=canary-us-east-1 /v1/health latency > 1200ms, failing 6/10 probes in 3m window. Probe run: synth-checker-5f6d7. Tags: region:us-east-1, env:prod
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-123456 assigned to Maya O (oncall). Escalation policy: SRE-OnCall -> SRE-Lead after 5m if unack'd.
Maya O: ack — I'm oncall, looking now. Paging in-channel for visibility. :eyes:
Devin H: looking at probe logs, attaching the last 2 probe traces. Might be a timeout vs downstream dependency.
Ken L: Any customer-facing 500s or user-reported errors?
Maya O: quick check of production error rate dashboards — no 5xx spike across public APIs. Only the synth endpoint shows timeouts. Could be a networking blip or probe agent.
Rachel S: I see a small tail in frontend traces around 12:10-12:14 UTC for us-east-1 with increased p95 by ~300ms, but not 5xx. Correlating with the synth times.
Devin H: running live probe: `curl -v https://api.prod.redwood.ai/v1/health -H 'x-synth: 1' -m 5`
Devin H: response is hanging, TCP completes but TLS handshake stalls then timeout at ~4.8s.
Maya O: thanks. I'm going to disable the scheduled canary job so it stops firing noisy alerts while we investigate. Putting a temporary pause via CI: `ci run synth-checker pause --env prod --region us-east-1`
Ken L: good call. Also can we restart the synth-checker pod? If probe agent has a leaked fd it could cause this.
Maya O: running: `kubectl -n observability rollout restart deploy/synth-checker`
Incident Bot: synth-checker deployment restart triggered by Maya O.
Devin H: after restart, issuing manual probes. First 3 probes: 200/200 with ~70ms. Looks healthy on the restart host.
PagerDuty Bot: Incident INC-123456 auto-acknowledged by Maya O at 12:17:08 UTC.
Maya O: leaving the canary disabled for 10m to observe. Will re-enable once stable.
Rachel S: I'm seeing the frontend p95 returning to baseline over the last 2 minutes. No customer-facing incidents recorded in Support.
Lucas_Support: double-checked support queue — no incoming tickets related to latency or errors for the affected window. Informing account teams as precaution.
Ken L: root cause hypothesis — probe agent on synth-checker node hit a transient resource starvation (ephemeral load from maintenance jobs), causing TLS handshake latency. Restart fixed it. Recommend adding a health-check and auto-restart to synth-checker, and add jitter to probe schedule across nodes.
Maya O: Agreed. I'll create a follow-up ticket and schedule a postmortem if we see recurrence. For now: resolution steps taken: disabled canary, restarted synth-checker, validated manual probes, re-enabled canary with reduced frequency.
Incident Bot: Summary: Incident INC-123456 resolved — probe failures stopped after restart and temporary pause. Closed at 12:24:00 UTC.
Maya O: marking as resolved in-thread. Follow-up action items: (1) add liveness probe for synth-checker (2) add alert suppression logic for consecutive transient failures (3) run a canary job game day to validate auto-recovery. I'll file the ticket and loop in Ken/Rachel/Devin. :white_check_mark:
Devin H: noted. I'll draft the runbook update and attach diagnostic logs to the ticket.
Ken L: thanks all. If anything flares back up, re-open PD incident and tag SRE-Lead.
Lucas_Support: will notify account managers with a short blurb: "No customer impact detected; internal probe recovered after automated restart."
Maya O: closing thread. Thanks everyone. :pray:
